The Monster and the Master
27 September 2026
Romans 7:20-25
Chris Gee
#1 Consider Paul’s words in verse 21, that our sin is our worst and lifelong enemy. How does this humbling spiritual reality help us accurately live the Christian life?
#2 When it comes to fighting “fire with fire” in our spiritual lives, what truths, habits, and convictions can help us likewise expel the love of what is evil? What exactly might you say or do to encourage another brother and sister in Christ to also “fight fire with fire”?
#3 As you look to Romans 7:24, we can find ourselves resonating with Paul’s anguish over the wretchedness of sin. In moments like these, how does future hope of glorification (freedom from the presence of sin) give comfort to present challenges of our sanctification (being freed from the power of sin)?
